bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam thar las 'phags pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan tshul/

tei:div.tei:p: bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam thar las 'phags pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan tshul/

dang por rgyal po don grub mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon pa ste/ nyan thos pa na re/ skye ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i skyes bu rang rgyud pa gcig rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras su 'khrungs pa yin zer/ byang sems pa rnams ni/ 'di so so skye bo yang ma yin/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang ma yin zer/ gsang sngags pa rnams ni sngon bskal ba me long gi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba la/ lam lnga/ sa bcu bgrod nas sangs rgyas tshar ba de'i sprul pa yin zer/ gang ltar yang dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par thams cad mthun pas/ de yang thugs bskyed lugs mdo sde snying rje pad dkar las/ 'di dang po bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du gyur tshe thugs bskyed ces pa dang*/ bskal bzang las/ sman par gyur tshe thugs bskyed/ drin lan gsab par dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs kyi thang la/ shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du 'khrungs tshe thugs bskyed/ phung po gsum par tshong dpon gyi bu sngon dgar gyur tshe'am/ yang na rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur tshe/ sangs rgyas thub pa chen po'i drung du 'khar ba'i bum pa gcig dang*/ dkar sha pa ni rdog po lnga/ mchil lham zung gcig /gdugs gcig rnams phul nas/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*/ /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*/ khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'i smon lam btab nas thugs bskyed par bshad do/ /de rting bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags par/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can yan gyis grangs med dang po rdzogs/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad yan gyis grangs med gnyis pa rdzogs/ rnam gzigs yan gyi grangs med gsum pa rdzogs par bshad de/

rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung*/ /dang po shākya thub pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar 'dod do/ / grangs med kyi ngos 'dzin nyan thos pa'i lugs la mdzad nas dang po rdzogs pa lung las/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas/ /'dren pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar/ /bdun khri lnga stong tshang ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa lung las/ sangs rgyas legs mdzad nas bzung te/ /dbang po rgyal mtshan thug gi bar/ /bdun khri drug stong tshang ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa rdzogs pa lung las/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung bar dag tu/ /bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /zhes so/ /theg pa chen po'i lugs la/ gong ltar khyi'u sna nga byed kyi thugs bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ sa dang po ma thob kyi bar la bskal ba grangs med dang po/ de'i dus so so skye bo'i lus grangs med blangs rting tshogs kyi lam du zhugs nas/ dge ba spel ba dang*/ sbyor lam las 'bras la nges shes skyes te/ de'i bar la sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i tha ma la/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can yin no/ /de ltar sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob nas/ mthong lam chos nyid bden pa rdzogs te/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa nas/ sgom lam la zhugs/ sa gsum pa 'od byed pa/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ lnga pa sbyangs dka' ba/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ bdun pa ring du song ba'i sa thob pa man la/ grangs med gnyis pa'o// de'i bar la sangs rgyas bdun khri drug stong la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i tha ma la/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad yin no/ /de'i rting la sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob pa'i dus su/ byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar por gyur cing*/ de man gyi grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas/

de'i ring la sangs rgyas bdun khri bdun stong la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i tha ma la/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs yin no/ /de ltar bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas/ sa bcu non cing*/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu'i bar la/ sgom lam la sgom pa 'phel ste/ sa bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od dang*/ bcu gnyis pa ma chags padma can dang*/ bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs brnyes pa'i tshul 'og nas bshad pa ltar ro/ / thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis dngos la/ 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa lnga la| lhum su zhugs pa/ sku bltams pa/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa/ btsun mo khab tu bzhes pa/ rgyal srid bzung ba rnams so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i mdzad pa lnga ni/ rab tu byung ba/ dka' ba spyad pa/ chos 'khor skor ba/ cho 'phrul bstan pa/ bdud btul cing sangs rgyas pa rnams so/ khyad par can gyi mdzad pa gnyis ni/ rtag tu re ba rnams sun 'byin pa'i phyir/ mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa dang*/ phyi rabs spro ba skyed pa'i phyir/ sku gdung ring bsrel cha brgyad du bgos pa dang*/ byin rlabs 'byung ba'i mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi dang po/ dam pa tog dkar por gyur ste/ dga' ldan du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams su snyigs ma lnga bdo bar ni/ sems can tshe dang*/ nyon mongs dang*/ lta ba dang*/ dus kyi snyigs ma rnams la dgongs nas/ dus kyi snyigs ma ni pha dang bur 'thab pa/ tshe'i snyigs ma ni tshe lo brgya pa/ nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma dug lnga rags pa/ las kyi snyigs ma dge ba chung du spyod pa/ lta ba'i snyigs ma log par spyod pa'o/ /gdul bya dus la babs par shes nas/ rtsod ldan gyi dus/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams tshe lo brgya pa'i skabs su/ dga' ldan du rgyal tshab byams pa la dbang bskur nas/ 'dzam bu gling du gzigs pa lnga'i sgo nas/ 'byon par chas pa ni/ gnas dang rigs rgyud yab yum dus dang lnga la gzigs nas/

yul ni ser skya la sogs pa grong khyer drug la gzigs/ rigs rgyal rigs la gzigs/ yab zas gtsang ma la gzigs/ yum sgyu ma lha mdzes la gzigs/ dus yum gso sbyong mdzad pa'i dus la gzigs/ nga ni 'dzam bu gling du chos ston pa la 'gro'o gsungs pas/ lha thams cad ma dga' ste/ thabs sna tshogs pa'i gshol btabs kyang ma thebs pa dang*/ lha'i bu gzi brjid dam pas de ltar na/ glang po che'i gzugs su sprul nas byon na/ don che'o zer ba ltar/ glang chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan gcig tu sprul nas byon/ grong khyer ser skya'i pho brang na/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma yab yum rgyal srid skyong gin bzhugs pa'i tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang ba la/ yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma gso sbyong la gnas pa'i spyi bo nas glang chen thims par rmis te/ lhums su zhugs nas yum la dga' bde'i ting nge 'dzin mang po thugs la 'khrungs par gyur to/ /de'ang jo bo rjes bzhed pa'i/ sangs rgyas shing pho byi ba'i dbyar 'bring po'i nya la lhums su zhugs/ glang lo dpyid tha chung gi tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ sa mo phag la sangs rgyas/ shing pho spre'u lo mya ngan 'das par bshad cing*/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta ni me mo yos la lhums su zhugs par bzhed cing*/ sa pho 'brug la sku bltams/ spyir zla tha chung skar ma sa ga'i nya ba'i tshes bco lnga'i yang gcig na dbo zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin zer rgyal phur 'dzoms dus chu pho stag la sangs rgyas/ me mo smin drug zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi zla ba ri mgo la yol ba dang mya ngan las 'das phag la mya ngan las 'das par bzhed/ dpyid tha'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal la bltams par mthun no so/ /rgyal bu lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa de dang po'o/ /de ltar lhums su zla ba dgu ngo bcu bzhugs nas/ lum bi ni'i tshal du yum gyi phyag g.yas pas shing n+ya gro ta'i yal ga la 'jus pa'i 'ogartsib ma'i bar nas sku bltams/

lhas me tog gtor/ brgya byin dang tshangs pas bstan/ lha klu thams cad kyi mchod pa phul/ dga' bo dang nyer dga' bo la sogs pas sku khrus gsol/ sku las 'od zer 'phros bltams 'phral la phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun bor bas/ zhabs rjes la padma re re byung cing*/ dge mtshan che ba'i tshigs su bcad pa re re gsung dus yab kyis/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ /sa chen sogs bstod pa ni thub pa'i bstod pa'i thog ma'o// ston pa dang dus mnyam du yul dbus su rgyal po tshangs byin dang*/ padma chen po dang*/ dmag rgyal/ rtsib gyi mu khyud mtha' yas dang bzhi po la/ bu bzhi btsas pa ni/ gsal rgyal/ gzugs can snying po/ shar pa/ gtum po rab snang rnams yin no/ /byang sems sku bltams nas zhag bdun nas yum 'das te/ sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes/ sru mo skye dgu'i bdag mos 'go byas/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas 'phel skyed shin du che'o/ /rgyal bu bltams pa'i mdzad pa stai gnyis pa'o// gsum pa ni de'i dus ri bo gru 'dzin na/ drang srong nyon mongs med ces pa/ 'jig rten chags 'jig la mkhas pa gcig yod pa des/ 'od zer gyi snang ba de mthong nas/ sangs rgyas sku bltams par shes shing*/ gzhan yang mtshan ltas mkhan rnams na re/ 'di ni rgyal srid bskyangs na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur zhing*/ rab tu byung na 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon du nges par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs mtshan ltas shin du bzang bar bcad te/ /mtshan yang rgyal po don grub tu gsol lo/ /yang drang srong na re/ da lta rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mi 'byung bas/ 'di ni da ste lo sum cu rtsa lnga nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba la the tshom mi za zhing*/ bdag ni rgas pas 'di'i chos mi thob par 'chi'o/ /zhes zer nas mya ngan byed la/ tsha bo mes sbyin la| rgyal po 'di sangs rgyas dus khyed rab tu byung zhig zer ba ltar byas pas/

mes byin dgra bcom pa thob pa'i mtshan ni 'phags pa ka ta ya na'o// shākya'i rigs rnams kyi lha gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi drung du rgyal bu byon pas/ lha'i lhas phyag byas byung bas/ bcom ldan lha'i lha'o zhes pa dang*/ de'i lam na shākya'i rigs gdug pa can thams cad la 'tshe ba gcig yod pa des kyang btud pas shākya thub pa zhes grags so/ /de nas gzhon nu nyid nas yig dpon srin po'i go bya las 'bri klog dang*/ shākya'i srid sgrub las rts-is dang*/ blon po lhar bcas las 'phongs dang*/ byang sems bzang po len las glang po che'i gnya' bar bzhon pa sogs/ rgyal po'i bya ba rnams slob par brtsam pa tsam gyis mkhyen te/ lhas byin la sogs rgyal phran rnams dang*/ aṅga maṅga dhar sgyu rtsal 'gran dus/ zhabs kyi mthe bong gi glang po che'i ro dpag tshad gcig gi bar la skyur bas/ sa gshong nge song ba ser skya grong khyer gyi phyi rol na glang po gshong bya ba yod do/ /mda'i rtsal 'gran pas/ shing rta la bdun lcags kyi phag pa bdun dang bcas pa phug nas/ mda' zug pa'i rjes na mda' chu khron pa skyes zer ba/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu yod do/ /gzhan yang rkyal dang shing sdong gcod pa la sogs pa rtsal sna gang la yang sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pas gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi mdzad pa stai gsum pa'o/ /bzhi pa de nas rgyal po'i dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i dus su/ shākya lag na be con gyi bu mo grags 'dzin ma dang*/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i dus/ shākya du legs kyi bu mo sa mtsho ma dang*/ nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes dus shākya dril bu sgra'i bu mo/ shākya bza' ri dwags skyes ma rnams 'khor nyi khri nyi khri dang bcas pa khab tu blangs pa ni/ btsun mo khab tu bzhes pa'i mdzad pa stai bzhi pa'o/ /lnga pa de ltar lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar la ni/ rgyal srid tshul dang mthun pa bskyangs shing*/ yab kyis rgyal bu chos las yengs nas/

'jig rten gyi bya ba la blo 'bṛd pa'i phyir/ zhing pa'i mtha' rtogs su bcug pa'i tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mthong nas/ gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe/ /zhes pa'i sras la bstod pa mdzad do/ /der rting rgyal po chibs pa ngang pa gser ldan la chibs/ 'dun pas sna khrid de grong khyer gyi shar lho nub rnams su/ nyin rai byon pas na rgas 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal 'dun pas brda sbyar/ byang phyogs su byon nyin/ sprul pa'i dge slong dang mjal/ bzhon pa las babs te phyag byas/ bdag kyang 'di ltar rab tu byung ngo gsungs/ pho brang du log rab tu byung lugs ji ltar legs bsam pa kho na sems kyin bzhugs pas/ yab dang 'khor 'bangs thams cad kyis bslu brid dang*/ yengs thabs sna tshogs byed cing*/ mtshan mkhan na re/ da stai zhag bdun la rgyal bu rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zer bas/ yab dang khu bo mes po 'khor bcas thams cad kyis pho brang gi phyogs mtshams thams cad dpung dang bcas nas bsrungs/ btsun mo rnams kyis nang du glu gar dang bkur sti la sogs pas thugs yengs thabs byed do// de nas zhag bdun pa'i srod la/ rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ bdag gi btsun mo drug khri blang pa la gcig dang yang ma 'grogs na/ zas gtsang gi sras kyis bud med bsten ma nus pas dbang med du rab tu byung ba yin no zer ba'i yal ga yong bsam/ de spangs pa'i phyir/ de nub btsun mo dam pa grags 'dzin ma dang lhan cig gzims so/ /sras sgra can 'dzin lhums su zhugs so/ /tho rangs kyi cha zin pa dang*/ brgya byin gyis skul nas/ rta ngang pa gser ldan la chibs yab rgyal po mnal du song ba la bskor ba byas/ phyi phyag btsal nas/ 'dun pas kyang rta gsham du bzhon pa dang*/ lha'i bu bzhis rta'i rmig pa re re nas btegs nas/ dka' thub kyi nags la gtad de/ nam mkha' la myur bar byon no/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs pa'i mdzad pa ste lnga pa'o/

/drug pa ni/ der rgyal bu nam mkha' la byon pa la/ gzugs khams kyi lha man chad/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pas bsus shing spro ba skyed pas/ nam thun gcig na dka' thub kyi nags mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du brtol nas/ rang nyid kyi dbu skra rang nyid kyi gzhar ste/ rab du byung*/ 'dun pa la rta dang rgyan cha rnams bskur te/ ser skyar slog btang bas/ smre sngags 'don cing phyin pas zhag bdun la slebs tsam byung zhing*/ blon 'bangs rnams kyi rta la 'ju zhing ngus pas/ gser ldan de nyid du shi nas/ grong khyer sgra can du bram ze las drug la mkhas pa gcig tu skyes so/ /rgyal po rab tu byung ba'i dbu skra dang*/ ka shi ka'i na bza' rnams brgya byin gyis khyer nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum na rin po che las grub pa'i dbu skra'i mchod rten dang*/ na bza'i mchod rten bya ba bzhengs yod do/ / grong khyer dpe med kyi khyim bdag gi bus bzhag pa'i na bza'/ ngur smrig brgya byin gyi lag nas phul ba gsol te/ rang byung du bsnyen par rdzogs par gyur to/ /de nas yab dang rgyal po legs par rab gsal kyi rgyal bu gcig pur nags la 'dug ces pa thos nas/ 'khor lnga brgya btang bas/ lnga nyar gzhan rnams phyir slog btang ngo*/ /rab tu byung ba'i mdzad pa ste drug pa'o// bdun pa ni/ de nas 'khor lnga po yang khrid de chu bo na ra dzā ra'i 'gram du byon nas/ /lo drug tu dka' thub mdzad par zhing pa'i bu mo gnyis kyis 'o ma'i nying khu la/ lha'i bu gnyis kyi gzi brjid skyed pa'i sman btab nas drangs pa gsol bas/ sku lus gser btso ma'i mdog lta bur gyur nas/ de'i tshe 'khor lnga po yang ma dad par gyur nas/ rang re tsho wa ra ṇa sir 'gro zer song ngo*/ /dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa stai bdun pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ de nas byang sems kyis sangs rgya bar bzhed de/ 'od gsal gyi lha'i tshig bzhin rdo rje gdan la phyin pa'i lam du/

tshong dpon ga gon dang*/ bzang pos 'bras chan drangs pas/ gsol ba'i zhal phor la lha'i bu'i lhung bzed gsum phul ba gcig tu byin gyis brlabs nas gsol/ tshong dpon gyi lam gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir lha'i bkra shis don grub bya ba gsungs/ de nas yang gshegs pa'i lam du/ rtswa tshong bkra shis kyis phul ba'i rtswa rdo rje gdan gyi spo la byang chub kyi shing drung du gdan la bting nas/ ji srid zag med ma thob bar/ de srid skyil krung gshig mi bya/ /gsungs nas/ srod la lha'i bu'i bdud btul/ nam gung rab mtha'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad/ tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /

gsang sngags bla med pa rnams kyis byang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang de las 'og min du byon nas/ mngon par byang chub lnga'i stong pa nyid las byang chub pa/ gdan pad nyi las byang chub pa/ gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa/ thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa'o/ /gdams pa zhus ma thag tu de ltar sgom pa dang*/ sa bcu gcig pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob ste sangs rgyas skad/ 'di ni rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas zer ba dang yang mi 'gal lo/ /nges par 'og min du sangs rgyas pa ni/ stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'og min du/ /sangs rgyas par ni ma gyur na/ /'dod khams gzugs khams rnams su ni/ /sangs rgyas par ni mi mdzad do/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin no/ / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ste brgyad pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ de ltar sangs rgyas ma thag tu/ 'dul dka' ba'i skye bos zab mo'i chos zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig kho bos brnyes// su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'dug pas/ /mi smra nags kyi nang du gnas par byed/ /ces gsung nas chos ma gsungs/ go dka' la/ rang nyams su blang bar bya'o dgongs nas/ zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar la chos ma gsungs so/ /de'i rjes lha tshangs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pas/ gnang te 'khor rnams bsdu ba'i phyir/ ghaṇḍi brdung ba'i sgra la/ sangs rgyas slob mar gyur pa gang su dag/ deng 'dir ston pas chos kyi char 'bebs kyis/ /gang dag nyan par 'dod rnams 'dir byon la/ /zab mo rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon cig ang*/ /zhes pa'i skad gsal bar byung zhing*/ thog mar wā ra ṇa sir 'khor lnga sde bzang po la sogs theg dman gyi gang zag rnams la/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi nas/ bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ro/ /

gsum ni dang po sgrub pa'i 'khor lo/ /bar du chad pas bcad pa'i 'khor lo/ tha ma rung mthun gyi 'khor lo'o/ / 'khor lnga sde po/ ye shes khong chud kyi bsnyen par rdzogs par gyur cing*/ kun shes kauṇḍi n+yas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ gzhan bzhi po yang zag pa las sems grol lo// 'khor lnga kun shes kauṇḍi n+ya/ rta thul/ ming chen/ glang po/ bzang ldan no/ / pos chos gos ldum po gon ma shes pa 'od gsal gyi lhas brda bstan to/ /chos 'khor gnyis pa/ bya rgaud phung po'i ri la/ rab 'byor dang*/ sha ri'i bu la sogs pa/ 'khor dgra bcom pa dang*/ byang sems mang po la/ theg pa thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /chos 'khor gsum pa/ ri ma la ya dang*/ yangs pa can la sogs par/ don dam yang dag 'phags la sogs/ 'khor rnam bzhi'i byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ theg pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /de'i skabs shig tu/ yab rgyal po zas gtsang yang dge ba la bskul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yab rgyal po'i drung du btang*/ brda sbyar te/ shing n+ya gro ta'i kun dga' ra bar/ yab sras mjal nas/ 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la chos bstan cing*/ yab kyi rgyang nas gus pa'i phyag 'tshal/ dad pas bstod pa ni/ de yang 'di dang khyod la lan gsum du/ /thub pa khyod kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje che mnga' lha yi mchod pa'i gtso/ khyod 'dra 'jig rten ma mchis lta ci smos/ /mtshan ni don grub lags zhes mngon brjod pa| |pha dang ma yi bsam ste btags pa lags/ khyod kyi bsam rdzogs bdud rtsi brnyais pas na/ /don grub legs par nga don bdag gi 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod cing*/ yab rgyal po'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong*/ chos thos pas zag pa las sems rnam par grol lo/ /ston pa'i zhal nas dge slong 'char kas yab rgyal po dge ba la bskul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po de la/

gal te gzugs yod na 'jig rten gyi khams/ gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du mi shong ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs shin du rgya chen po gsungs so/ /de ltar chos 'khor rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i ring la/ lo bdun du zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu ma tshang ba song bar byed cing*/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas lo bdun lon pa'i dus sum cu rtsa gsum du yum la chos gsung ba la byon/ zhag dgu bcu bzhugs pa de'i bar la/ lha tshangs pa dang*/ gza' khyab 'jug lha'i dbang po brgya byin gsum gyis ston pa'i sku tshab re bzhengs par gsol ba btabs pas gnang ste/ tshangs pas lha'i rin po che las chos sku'i rten/ bum pa zlum por byas pa/ dpal reg pa med pa du ba lta bu'i mchod rten bzhengs pa'i tshad tshangs pa'i mtho gang ngo*/ /de mkha' 'gros gdan drangs o rgyan gyi yul he ru ka'i rgyal khams na bar snang la bzhugs te/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mi ma yin rnams kyi mchod pa'i rten byed/ mchog gi dngos grub stair ro/ khyab 'jug gi klu'i rin po che la/ longs sku'i rten rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i sku dpag tshad bcu gnyis yod pa gcig bzhengs/ de phyis rgya mtsho na bzhugs te/ klu dang gza' rnams kyi mchod pa'i rten byed do/ /brgya byin gyi lha mi'i rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ 'ching bu lnga bcu rtsa gcig la sprul sku'i rten/ sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa dang*/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sku tshad gsum bzhengs nas/ che ba de brgya byin rang gi yid dam mdzad/ chung ba gnyis rgya gar du rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi yi dam mdzad/ bar skabs nas rgya nag dang bal yul du phebs/ mthar bod du 'gro don la phebs par lung bstan pa bzhin da lta lha sa 'phrul snang dang*/ ra mo che na bzhugs pa'i jo bo mched gnyis yin no/ sku tshab rnams kyi rab gnas sangs rgyas nyid rang gis mdzad cing*/ lha bzo ba bi shwa karma dang*/ sku gnyair byams pa/

bka' srung phyag rdor dang dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lngas byas shing byed par dam bcas so/ /yang ston pa lha yul du bzhugs ring la rgyal po u tra ya na/ sems shin du skyo nas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu la bskul nas/ tsan dan go shirṣa la ston pa'i sku tshab lha yul du bzhengs rab gnas zhus te/ mi yul du spyan drangs/ phyis rgya nag tu phebs nas/ tsan dan jo bor grags pa yod/ paṇa chen shākya shrī ltar na/ tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la lha las babs pa'i dus chen yod par bzhed/ smin drug zla ba'i tshes bzhi la/ sum cu rtsa gsum nas mi yul du phebs pa ni/ dpal lha las babs pa'i dus mchod zhes bya'o/ /de ltar theg pa chung ngu'i chos rnams ni/ gang la gang 'tsham par bstan zin gyis/ theg chen bla med kyi chos rnams/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams la gsal bar ston pa'i dus skabs la ma slebs par dgongs nas/ sprul pas gsungs pa ni/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal du sprul nas/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal du bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/ 'og min du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs/ rgya gar lho phyogs shrī dharma pha la chos kyi 'byung gnas su byon/ rdo gru gsum snol ba'i steng du/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams ni/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ mi ma yin rnams la gsungs pa'o/ /de rnams chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa stai dgu pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ de dag gi skabs su ston pa la tho mtshams zhing bar du gcod pa brtsam par 'dod pa'i bdud dang mu stegs rnams pham par mdzad pa ni/ 'khor mo 'jigs pa'i yul du bdud btul ba'i dus na/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed nas bdud rje dga' rab dbang phyug kho yang*/ lha'i bu'i bdud dgu khris bskor nas byung te/ go'u ta ma khyod kyi bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags zer ba'i rdzun gtong bar 'dug pa/

de'i dpang por su yod zer ba la/ ston pas/ sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi rten yin te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu mnyam shing nye ring med/ /de ring khyod kyi gzu dang dpang mdzod shig /gsungs pa dang*/ sa'i lha mo bstan ma byung nas lus phyed tsam pa steng du btaun/ thal mo sbyar nas/ de nges par bden no zer bas/ bdud rje skyengs te dpa' bkong zhing*/ bdud kyi sde rnams pham par gyur to/ /der rting gnyan yod du mu stegs kyi ston pa chen po rdzogs byed dang*/ gnag lhas kyi bu ka ti dang*/ rnam par smra ba'i bu kun tu rgyal ba dang*/ mi pham skra'i lwa ba can dang*/ ka ta'i bu nog can dang*/ gcer bu gnyen gyi bu ste rtog ge pa drug po bram ze rgyus rgyal dang bram ze rnam rdeg dang*/ bram ze bzang ldan dang*/ bram ze tshangs pa'i ched/ bram ze padma'i snying po dang*/ bram ze dmar po ste rjes su snyeg pa drug dang*/ rengs byed kyi bu lhag gcod dang*/ sgyu rtsal can gyi bu rings 'phur dang*/ kun tu rgyu rab bzang dang*/ bram ze bu kun rgyal dang*/ drang srong nyon mongs med dang*/ steng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can te/ snyom par 'jug pa drug stai/ ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad kyi ma rung bar bgyis pas/ gshegs pa'i skabs ma legs zhes gsol bas/ nyi ma'i 'od dang 'od gzhan ltar/ de dag chos dang ma 'dres shing*/ de dag nga nyid kyis zil gyi mnan nus so zhes gsung*/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ rta'i zla ba'i tshes gcig nas/ bco lnga'i bar nyin re bzhin cho 'phrul bstan nas/ bdud dang mu stegs thams cad tshar bcad nas nang pa'i sgor bcug pa ni/ bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa stai bcu pa'o/ /ston pa sangs rgyas nyid ni bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs na'ang dbang thob te/ bdud kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ mya ngan las 'da' bar zhal gyi bzhes tshar ba dang*/ rtag 'dzin can rnams mi rtag pa la bskul ba'i ched du/ mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed de/

grong khyer rtswa mchog tu chos kyi tha ma gsungs pa'i dus na/ 'khor gyi nang nas rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po kun dza ra bya ba stan las langs/ pus mo btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das khyed kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bstan tshar ro gsungs mod kyang*/ bstan pa'i snying po zab mo'i lam gsang sngags bla na med pa'i theg pa dag 'dzam gling 'dir ma gsungs so zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ nga ni 'di nas ma snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis nas/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i sar/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig/ 'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ /mi lha skal ldan grags ma byed/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /sngon du ltas rnams snang gyur te/ /drag shul can zhes bya ba'irtse// grogs kyi sems la dag pa'i lus/ /lang ka'i bdag po la sogs la/ /phyag na rdo rjes ston par 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /der 'khor thams cad mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa la/ 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /nga ni nges par mya ngan las 'da' bas/ lus gser mdog 'di la yang yang ltos/ phyis mya ngan ma byed cig 'dus byas thams cad 'di dang 'dra'o gsungs shing*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur tai/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul bstan tsam/ /gsungs pa la/ de ltar na cis kyang bzhugs par gsol ba btabs pas/ sa steng 'jig rten gang na yang*/ /skyes nas 'chi bar ma gyur tam/ /gang zhig khyod kyi ma mthong ngam/ /'on te mthong na'ang the tshom za/ /nga yi mya ngan khyod byed na/ khyod kyi mya ngan sus byed pa| |de la 'bras bu gang yang med/ /gsungs pa de ni chos kyi phyi ma'o/ /der dbu nub tu bstan/ zhal lhor gzigs/ zhabs shar la brkyang*/ phyag g.yas 'og tu bcug phyag g.yon brla'i steng du bskyal nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu tham pa bzhes pa'i sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad jo bo rje lugs kyi nam gung*/

zla ba ri mgo'i rtser nub pa'i dus su/ gyad kyi yul grong khyer rtsa mchog der chos kyi dbyings su mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i mdzad pa ste bcu gcig pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ der sa g.yo ba dang*/ sgra 'byin pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ lha rnams kyi bsus nas 'og min stug po bkaud pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /sku gdung ni bka' bzhin dri bzang pos byugs ras yug stong dang*/ 'bru mar gyi dril nas/ zhag bdun nas zhugs la 'bul snyam par// ston pa nyid rang gi thugs dpal be'u nas me rang 'bar du ston nas bzhu'o/ gdung rus dang ring bsrel la maṅga dha'i bre bcu gnyis byung tshems mche ba g.yas pa| brgya byin gyi gdan drangs/ gzhan rnams cha brgyad bgos ste khyer nas/ mchod rten kyang brgyad bzhengs so/ / bram ze legs mdzes spun gyi gdung thal la mchod rten bzhengs so/ / ston pas byin gyis brlabs pas bi shwa karmas bzo bslabs ma dgos par shes te/ sku tshab bzhengs pa'i thugs kar/ sangs rgyas rang gi thugs dpal be'u dang*/ sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying pos byur bur bskangs te/ byang chub gyi snying po maṅga dha rdo rje gdan na bzhugs so/ /phyi rabs spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ sku gdung ring bsrel rnams byin rlabs kyi rten du bzhag pa'i mdzad pa stai bcu gnyis pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam thar las 'phags pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan tshul/ -PAGE 16--PAGE 31--PAGE 15-
